messages:
maria: Heads up — canary users seeing Metric Explorer small-multiples freeze when panning + opening tooltips. Started right after the 11:01 deploy, UI hangs ~3-5s.

dustin: repro'd on my canary. Main thread spikes. Devtools shows a big JSON.parse of telemetry payload around the hover time (~1s parse).

raj: any idea what changed in deploy? routing policy tweak or kv cache?

maria: not routing. Telemetry sampling change was included in the same deploy — seeing a payload size jump in recent events.

telemetry-bot: sample_rate updated -> 1% -> 5% at 11:02. New envelope includes optional `raw_span` field; some traces now +700-900KB.

elaine: large payloads hitting the main thread JSON parse would explain the UI stalls. Did we fall back to main-thread parsing anywhere?

sam: we had moved parsing to a worker previously but rolled that out back when a service-worker scope change caused navigation regressions. Might be on stable we lost the off-main path.

dustin: quick local repro (sanitized):

```
# simulate big telemetry envelope
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.canary/api/telemetry -d '{"sample_rate":0.05,"trace":"<very-large-raw_span>..."}'
# then open Metric Explorer and hover a point
```

raj: timeline looks clean: deploy 11:01, telemetry schema + sampling 11:02, canary rise in hover latency immediately after. Canary vs stable diff is convincing.

maria: mitigation options: rollback the `raw_span` injection in telemetry service for frontend consumers, or re-enable worker parsing in the client. Rolling back server-side is fastest.

dustin: I have a tiny client patch ready to guard large payloads and offload to a worker:

```
if (payload.length > 100 * 1024) queueWorkerParse(payload)
else JSON.parse(payload)
```

sam: UX: for the cases we offload or skip heavy traces, we should show "trace omitted (size)" in tooltip with a link to view full trace asynchronously. Otherwise users will wonder why data missing.

elaine: ops note — unrelated, but check routing: some telemetry flows travel via the eu-proxy and might add latency to ingestion. This is CPU stall, though, not network.

raj: plan: 1) rollback raw_span inject on canary now, 2) hotfix client to worker-parse + threshold, 3) add a 95th-pct payload-size alert and dashboard, 4) add e2e perf test for Metric Explorer with big traces.

maria: rolling back canary now. @dustin can you open the hotfix PR and tag @sam for the tooltip copy?

dustin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/987 (adds worker parse, 100KB threshold, safe fallback). Tests included.

sam: I'll draft tooltip copy and add a small UX acceptance test.

telemetry-bot: rollback completed for canary at 11:25 UTC. Telemetry ingress now dropping `raw_span` for frontend consumers by default.

maria: verified — canary hover latency back to baseline and snappy. Thanks everyone :tada: 

raj: follow-ups (backlog): add unit test for worker fallback path, add an e2e perf scenario for Metric Explorer with synthetic large traces, and add a quick routing-policy audit for telemetry endpoints to ensure no unexpected proxies are adding churn.

dustin: noted. I'll add the tests in the hotfix branch and file follow-up tickets.

maria: closing the loop — will update the rollout playbook so telemetry schema changes require a canary-only opt-in and a perf smoke test.

sam: nice catch, team.
